name: shape-emitter
source_tree_rule: sha256 of the LC_ALL=C-sorted sha256sum listing of every file under contracts/ except target directories, paths relative to contracts/
build_command: SOROBAN_SDK_BUILD_SYSTEM_SUPPORTS_SPEC_SHAKING_V2=1 CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS='--remap-path-prefix=$CARGO_HOME=/cargo --remap-path-prefix=<contracts>=/contracts' cargo build --locked --release --target wasm32v1-none -p shape-emitter -p custom-account -p token-shape; wasm-post shake <built>.wasm <name>.wasm
